facts: The shop is at the entrance intersection of Jungmun Tourist Complex, 875 Iljuseo-ro, Seogwipo.
It is a Jeju-style souvenir shop selling Jeju-related fashion goods, stationery, mugs, soaps, candles and magnets.
A cafe operates in part of the shop; bottled wine and processed foods produced in Jeju are also sold.
It is open 10:30–21:30 year-round and has free parking for about 70 cars across two parking areas.
The operator presents itself as a shop where Jeju souvenirs and gifts are gathered.
The official site provides a branch-location section.
Visit Jeju identifies 선물가게 바나나 as a Jeju souvenir shop with several branches in Jeju.
Its description documents Jeju-themed goods, Jeju snacks such as Udo peanut sandwiches and tangerine chocolate, and proprietary souvenir goods.

theme.mountain.rationale: Reviewed sources define a souvenir-and-gift retail visit; no mountain experience is offered.

theme.ocean.rationale: The Jungmun location is a retail shop; nearby beaches do not make ocean activity part of this place's experience.

theme.activity.rationale: Browsing and purchasing souvenirs involve light activity, but the documented purpose is not active recreation or a hands-on program.

theme.culture_history.rationale: Jeju-themed goods and regional food products give a limited cultural-shopping connection, without a documented heritage, museum, or history interpretation program.

theme.theme_park.rationale: Sources classify it as shopping/souvenir retail, not an amusement or themed attraction facility.

theme.cafe.rationale: A cafe is documented inside one part of the shop, but souvenir retail remains the primary place identity.

theme.traditional_market.rationale: It is an individual retail souvenir shop rather than a traditional or periodic market.

theme.festival.rationale: The documented operation is year-round retail; no festival is identified as the core visit purpose.

environment.indoor_ratio.rationale: The visit is centred on an indoor shop with an in-shop cafe and merchandise displays; parking is ancillary rather than the experience space.

environment.weather_sensitivity.rationale: The retail and cafe experience is primarily indoors, so weather should have limited influence after arrival.

style_evidence.restfulness.rationale: Shopping is the primary documented activity. The small cafe adds a rest option but does not establish a restorative or quiet-destination purpose.

style_evidence.physical_ease.hold_reason: The sources confirm free parking but do not state entrance steps, interior circulation, accessible toilets, or barrier-free facilities.
style_evidence.physical_ease.rationale: Do not infer full physical ease from a retail classification or parking availability alone.

style_evidence.visit_duration_flexibilit.rationale: A year-round, 10:30–21:30 retail shop with optional cafe use permits brief shopping or a longer browse without a timed tour.

style_evidence.scenic_value.rationale: The reviewed descriptions focus on goods, cafe, and parking; they do not identify a landscape, viewpoint, or scenic setting as part of the visit.

style_evidence.distinctiveness.rationale: The Jeju-focused assortment, processed local foods, and proprietary souvenir goods distinguish it from a generic convenience store, but sources do not establish an exceptional singular attraction.

style_evidence.local_embeddedness.rationale: This is a Jeju-based multi-branch souvenir brand whose documented assortment includes Jeju-themed goods and Jeju-produced foods. It is not scored as 1 because the evidence describes tourism retail rather than community, heritage, or primary local production activity.

style_evidence.landmark_significance.rationale: Neither public tourism nor operator sources establish landmark, designated-heritage, or iconic-attraction status; its location near Jungmun attractions is insufficient.

style_evidence.photo_value.hold_reason: Available sources include product/shop images but no credible designation or evidence that this branch is a photography destination.
style_evidence.photo_value.rationale: Jeju-themed merchandise may be visually appealing, but photo value is not inferred from generic retail imagery.

derived_style.discovery_explorer.hold_reason: Current derived rule has no independently researched place-specific input.

common_rule_proposals.proposal: 제주 내 여러 지점만 확인된 제주 기념품 브랜드는 전국·글로벌 체인처럼 local_embeddedness=0으로 처리하지 말고, 제주 기반 운영과 제주 상품·생산품의 직접 근거가 함께 있을 때 0.75까지 평가한다.
common_rule_proposals.basis: 선물가게 바나나는 제주 내 다지점과 제주 기념품·제주 생산 가공식품 판매가 공공 관광 및 운영자 출처에 확인된다.
